summary.title: The City in Yellow: Six Spires and the Shaping
summary.synopsis: The party completes a sequence of six spire trials across the City in Yellow on Ilkain, each one progressively rebuilding the decaying fungal city and transforming its faceless inhabitants into living Thessians. After learning that Thessians evolved from three-armed, radially symmetric starfish-like creatures, stabilizing the city's sky, life cycle, and geometry, the party ascends the central hill to find Karkov's body puppeted by the Deep, who announces it is time to shape them into their "ascended, true, perfect forms."
key_beats: Combat resumes against fungal tree creatures (a sard and a fungal triceratops) in the City in Yellow; Don obliterates the triceratops with a 140-damage magic punch, and Henrik finishes the sard with a 124-damage critical strike.

After combat, a fairy ring of blue fungal growth with a floating yellow bulb appears; Divex's occultism check reveals the growths share ancestry with the city and that a convection cell of energy flows between the rings. Lev touches the bulb, which bursts and rebuilds the city into pristine condition; the Spire of History fires a beam of light, reducing everyone's 'unworthy' stacks from six to five.

At the Spire of Hierarchy, a throne, guillotine, and lectern emerge; Lev sits the throne as presiding judge, Henrik is locked in the guillotine as the accused (charged with treason, terrorism, theft, and more). Dawn at the lectern and Lev both fail to save him with beams of light striking the wrong ruler; Lev finally pardons Henrik with a 63 Diplomacy check, springing the guillotine but leaving Henrik with a ball-and-chain community service sentence.

After the Hierarchy trial, the city's inhabitants gain intricate clothing and the party receives translucent stoles reading 'Heir Apparent'; the people are revealed as gray-skinned, three-legged, three-armed, faceless Thessians who kneel in respect.

At the Spire of Origin (a glass greenhouse with a fountain reading 'Return to your origin'), the party experiments with animals — Don turns green from a leaf, Divex gains chitin from an insectoid, Henrik grows bear fur then bull horns, Divex becomes a tiger, then a myconid; Don drinks from the fountain while holding the three-pointed starfish and transforms into a Thessian form — gray skin, tripod legs, third arm, faceless mask, psychic speech, and topological vision — revealing starfish as the Thessian evolutionary origin.

At the Spire of Sky, an obsidian dome contains a golden orrery with ten boring, uniform rocky planets and incorrectly positioned painted stars; the party removes all planets but one (made yellow) and erases all the stars, stabilizing the orbit and triggering the change — the city's sky becomes black and starless, and the background drone shifts to organ music.

At the Spire of Cycle, a white dome contains a tallow candle, a yellow sapling, a Thessian skull, and a shrieking Thessian baby on a pedestal; the party deduces the life cycle (bone meal fertilizes the sapling, the baby eats the plant, the baby dies and becomes tallow) and places all four items into alcoves in the correct order on the first try.

At the Spire of Geometry, the party falls through a void with a square platform and a lever that redirects gravity; after multiple jumps, lever pulls, and falling rotations, all four land on a circular platform that descends, completing the trial and stabilizing the city's non-Euclidean geometry into proper form. All become 'worthy.'

The party ascends the central hill and finds a Giant fungal organ played by Karkov's body, puppeted by the Deep — a flat yellow faceplate with a single red eye and marionette strings. The Deep speaks through Karkov: 'Welcome. It is time for you to be shaped to your ascended, true, perfect forms.'
locations: Spire of Sky (obsidian dome with orrery)
The central hill / staircase of the City in Yellow
factions: Thessians (inhabitants of the City in Yellow)
summary.cliffhanger: The Deep, looming 150 feet above and puppeteering Karkov's fungal-covered body like a marionette at the top of the city's central hill, announces: 'Welcome. It is time for you to be shaped to your ascended, true, perfect forms.' — setting up a confrontation as the party debates whether to needle the Deep before or after dealing with Karkov.
